verifications.evidence: TECH-SPEC.md:38 states GS5 requires no SKILL.md, but TECH-SPEC.md:205-208 (section 3.9) requires 'Each command is one SKILL.md' for user-command skills, a direct contradiction within the same document.

PRD-v2.md:254 lists the release tree as 'pi/index.js' with no package.json next to it, and line 15.3's canonical install path gives Pi no package.json either, matching the claim that Pi's manifest-less auto-scan (extensions/skills/prompts/themes) would never load a bare pi/index.js file.

ADR-0002 (read in full) has no Corruption section at all; the only corruption rule lives in PRD-v2.md:84 ('--fix deletes only that session DB... No silent recreate'), while ADR-0002:18 says 'No npm publish, no CLI' — so the PRD's named 'context-mode doctor --fix' CLI command conflicts with ADR-0002's own CLI ban, and no mid-session corruption case is covered anywhere.

ADR-0008 row 2 (line 25) only conditions curl/wget allow on 'body does not reach the tool output' (file output or bounded sink); v1's cm-main hooks/core/routing.mjs:745-762 (commit 2731ca25, #166) additionally required a silent flag and rejected verbose/trace flags to stop stderr progress-bar floods — both conditions are absent from the v2 text, so the regression is real.

ADR-0011 step b (lines 30-33, cited as line 31) edits only '.claude-plugin/marketplace.json' and names 'codex plugin marketplace upgrade' as the Codex update command, with no mention of '.agents/plugins/marketplace.json' anywhere in the ADR; since existing Codex installs (per the finding's commit 1e73a13d) read that second file first, the upgrade path for those users is genuinely undocumented.

The doc's identity-detection claim rests entirely on external gemini-cli source (not present in this worktree) cited at line 18; the cited ADR line is plausible given the architecture described but cannot be checked against the actual gemini-cli repo from here, so it is downgraded from a verified blocker to an unverified claim pending a live check against that external codebase.

map-I1.md:14 (#1090) requires command to be plain 'node', but cm-main src/adapters/claude-code/index.ts:129-131 comment states verbatim that dropping the process.execPath swap 're-opened the Windows class' fixed by v1 commits f69b0d27 (#190, snap/PATH) and d6ac3826 — the proposed test directly reverses a documented, intentional fix.

map-P0.md:48 (#1231) verdict 'hints must cover external MCP tools' is squarely at odds with PRD-v2.md:103 'Never every mcp__* (#960 #897 #1212 #1222)', and ADR-0008's scope table (lines 8-16) has no external-MCP row at all, so the two governing docs disagree exactly as the finding states.
